--
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Manoj Kumar Choubey, Advocate

For the State : Ms. Sushma Aind, A.P.P  ---
02/06.06.2023 Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has moved this Court for gr privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint Case No. 1057 of 2021, for the offence under Sections 498A of I.P.C.
Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 appears and seeks adjournment for filing Vakalatnama.
Since it is a matrimonial dispute, I am inclined to grant the privilege of provisional anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, the above-named applicant is directed to surrender in the court below and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the Court below shall enlarge the above named applicant,
on provisional bail for two months from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of A.C.J.M., Garhwa in connection with Complaint Case No. 1057 of 2021, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.

Further, the applicant will submit self attested copy of his Aadhar Card and also give his mobile number before the learned court below, which he will not change during pendency of this case without prior permission of the Court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J) jk Gyan Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 6 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197311006/
